hero.title: Hi, I'm Pablo.
hero.intro: Machine Learning Engineer from 🇪🇸 Spain, based in 🇹🇼 Taiwan and working in the semiconductor industry.
hero.specialization: I build production-grade ML systems, specializing in data pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, IaC (Infrastructure as Code), and autonomous agentic workflows.
hero.hobbies: In my spare time, I develop tools at the intersection of creativity and audio.

engineeringFocus.title: Engineering Focus
engineeringFocus.lead: With a formal background in Electronic Engineering and Computer Science, I have worked across the US, Spain, Portugal, China, and Taiwan on:

areas.title: Production ML & Infrastructure
areas.description: Designing end-to-end ML pipelines, automating deployment with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and MLOps practices.

areas.title: Agent Development & Applied AI
areas.description: Building agentic systems, LLM-driven tooling, and behavioral analytics / fraud detection systems.

areas.title: Audio & Creative Tech
areas.description: Research in deep learning for music generation and DSP hardware design for guitar effects.

coffeeChat.title: Say Hi / Coffee Chat
coffeeChat.description: I enjoy meeting new people and keep an open door for anyone curious about moving to Taiwan, breaking into machine learning and semiconductors, or hacking on music tech and audio hardware.
coffeeChat.mentorship: Over the past few years, I’ve also mentored university students through IMFAHE.
coffeeChat.invitation: Feel free to grab a slot on my calendar to chat or just say hello:
